provenance: Project-authored synthetic scenarios. Held-out wording/parameters were frozen before execution, but authors know the implementation and supported recipes; not independently authored human data. No classifier retraining or prompt tuning on these held-out results.
approval_policy: The evaluation harness explicitly approves concept proposals solely to exercise CAD. The product still requires user approval.

cases.prompt: Make an open-top electronics enclosure 100 mm long, 60 mm wide and 35 mm high, with 3 mm walls and base.

edit.prompt: Make it 20 mm longer; preserve all other measurements.

cases.prompt: Create a cooking robot with default settings.
Design an open-top enclosure for a sensor: length 84 mm, width 56 mm, height 32 mm. Both wall and base thickness are 2 mm.

edit.prompt: Increase the enclosure length by 12 mm. Leave the width, height and thicknesses unchanged.

cases.prompt: I need a shallow rectangular tray for small parts: 132 mm long, 88 mm wide and 18 mm high. Use 2 mm walls, a 3 mm base and an open top.

edit.prompt: Add 12 mm to the tray width without changing any other parameter.

cases.prompt: Create an L-shaped mounting bracket. The foot reaches 72 mm, width is 48 mm, upright height is 60 mm and both plates are 4 mm thick. Put one 6 mm through hole on each face using the standard placement.

edit.prompt: Extend the bracket foot reach by 8 mm; keep the upright, plate thickness and holes the same.

cases.prompt: Create a display table concept with a 280 mm by 180 mm tabletop that is 16 mm thick. Include four cylindrical legs, each 220 mm tall. Use sensible defaults for leg diameter and colors.

edit.prompt: For the selected tabletop only, increase its X dimension by 40 mm. Leave all legs and all other fields unchanged.

cases.prompt: Build a walking toy robot concept: a 180 mm cube body, four straight legs 140 mm tall, and two camera eyes. Use sensible defaults for the remaining visual details.

edit.prompt: Change only the selected body color to #c43d32. Preserve every component ID, dimension, position and other color.

cases.prompt: Make an electronics enclosure for a circuit board. I have not decided its length, width or height; ask me before choosing dimensions.
